snippet.title: Shardpunk 2 - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Empire has fallen. The Capitol lies in ruins. And something in the rubble is stirring.

Shardpunk 2 is a turn-based tactical RPG blending XCOM-style combat with Darkest Dungeon pressure, outpost management, and a post-apocalyptic world teetering on the edge of a New Dawn.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4110720/Shardpunk_2/

The sacrifice of the Capitol - humanity's greatest metropolis, destroyed to halt the rat swarm - changed the course of the war. Now its ruins are the focus of desperate expeditions launched by the Motherland, the power rising from the Empire's remnants.

As commander of a forward outpost, you lead teams into the collapsed avenues and haunted plazas of the Capitol. Scavenge for fusion cores, rare crystals, and amber - a resin whose newly-discovered properties may yet reshape humanity's future. The rat horde was slowed, not stopped. And something else is lurking in the ruins now.

There are no safe turns. And no easy choices.

⚔️ Tactical Combat - XCOM-style turn-based battles with high stakes and no margin for error.
🏛️ Outpost Management - Expand your base, fulfill Motherland directives, and keep your troops alive under constant resource pressure.
👥 Deep Roster - Multiple soldier classes, hundreds of skills, wide equipment variety, and evolving squad relationships.
⚡ Amber Technology - Harness newly-discovered amber-based abilities alongside existing shard-powered gear.
🎨 Chunky Pixel Art - A lush, detailed post-apocalyptic world rendered in rich pixel art.
📜 Compelling Narrative - Scavenge the Capitol, uncover its secrets, and face the consequences of an apocalypse humanity brought upon itself.

#Shardpunk2 #IndieGame #TurnBased #TacticalRPG #PixelArt #PCGaming #Strategy #IndieGameTrailer
